summary.en: The PIME input method framework lists native Windows 11 ARM64 support in the 2.0.0 beta releases.
summary.zh-TW: PIME 輸入法平台在 2.0.0 測試版中列出原生 Windows 11 ARM64 支援。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Only the 2.0.0 pre-releases mention ARM64; the stable 1.3.0 does not.
caveats.zh-TW: 只有 2.0.0 預覽版提到 ARM64；穩定版 1.3.0 沒有。

evidence.title: PIME releases: v2.0.0-beta4 "Windows 11 ARM64 原生支援"
